h1.en: Output and distance decide whether the DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp row fits
h1.zh: 输送量和距离决定DN80混凝土泵管卡这一行是否合适

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Copy only the printed cells: Part type Hinged pipe clamp / coupling; Standard mark EN14420-3; Nominal size DN80 / 3″ / 89; Pressure mark PN10/16; Features Hinge, tightening bolt, grease nipple, two-hole base; Commercial terms No small-batch shipping; no published list price. This page does not print a theoretical output. Do not invent m³/h. Ask Xingtai which listed machine matches the rate you need. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Retaining_wall. It shows: An example of crib wall. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.

body.en: Put /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80 in the subject. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
